templates.T0: Approach the {color} target and align the tool with its axes.
templates.T1: Bring the tool to the {color} marker with the pose shown by its axes.
templates.T2: Position the tool at the {color} target and match the orientation of its displayed axes.
templates.T3: Guide the tool to the {color} marker and align it with the marker's axes.
templates.T4: The {color} target is the destination for the tool; match the orientation shown by its axes.
templates.T5: Match the tool's position and orientation to the {color} marker and its displayed axes.
templates.T6: Bring the tool into alignment with the displayed axes at the {color} target.
templates.T7: Use the {color} marker as the tool's target position and use its axes as the target orientation.
